**Finding: missing — insurance covenant absent (severity: low)**

The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere: a full-text search for "insurance" returns nothing, and the miscellaneous block (Sections 13–30, ending with Force Majeure at p0097) goes straight from Force Majeure to signatures. TrueLink hosts the Client web site, operates the Interface and handles Client Content and credit-repository data, so an uninsured vendor here sits in the playbook's walk-away zone.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: a new **Section 31 (Insurance)** inserted after p0097 at the preferred levels — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for processing of Client data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request, maintained through the term plus one year. Placement after the last numbered section preserves the existing numbering and the Section 24 survival reference to "Sections 1 and 5 through 30." The comment offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback if TrueLink pushes back on limits.
